ESP.ORIGINAL: The Green Pact is a strict code upheld by the Bosmer of Valenwood that forbids harming the forest. Its Meat Mandate involves strict carnivory and the rite of consuming the flesh of fallen foes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 绿色契约是瓦伦森林的波斯莫所遵守的严格准则，禁止伤害森林。其中的“食肉令”要求严格食肉，并包括食用倒下的敌人之肉的仪式。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Regarded as the finest archers in Tamriel, Wood Elves can draw and release arrows in one seamless motion - a skill enhanced by their talent for blending into wooded environments.
ESP.TRADUIT: 木精灵被视为泰姆瑞尔最优秀的弓箭手，能一气呵成地拉弓放箭——他们融入森林环境的天赋更增强了这项技能。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Bretons are a pale-skinned hybrid race from High Rock, claiming both human and elven ancestry. Their attunement to the mercurial forces of magic distinguishes them from other human races.
ESP.TRADUIT: 布莱顿人是来自高岩的浅肤色混血种族，兼有凡人与精灵血统。他们与变幻莫测的魔法力量亲和，这使他们有别于其他人类种族。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Although tales of warring kingdoms account for much of the history of High Rock, the Bretons maintain a rich cultural unity with shared language, bardic traditions, and fabled stories of heroism.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽管关于交战王国的传说构成了高岩历史的大部分，布莱顿人仍以共同的语言、吟游传统和传奇的英雄故事维持着丰富的文化统一。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Knighthood is pivotal to the Breton identity, as knights of old liberated their forebears from elven rule and created a legacy for future generations through daring quests for glory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 骑士精神对布莱顿人的身份至关重要，因为古代骑士将他们的祖先从精灵统治下解放出来，并通过勇敢追求荣耀的冒险为后代留下了遗产。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Dunmer, also known as Dark Elves, are the gray-skinned elven inhabitants of Morrowind. They possess an innate resistance to fire and can skillfully integrate swords, bows, and Destruction magic in battle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 暗精灵是晨风的灰皮肤精灵，天生抗火，能在战斗中巧妙结合剑、弓与毁灭系魔法。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Dark Elves trace their origins to the bygone Chimer, who abandoned the ways of Summerset Isle in pursuit of religious freedom. Guided by the prophet Veloth, they undertook a great exodus to Morrowind.
ESP.TRADUIT: 暗精灵的起源可追溯到已消失的奇莫，他们为了追求宗教自由而放弃夏暮岛的方式。在先知维洛斯的引导下，他们向晨风进行了大迁徙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As punishment for the betrayal of Indoril Nerevar, the Dunmer were cursed by the Daedric Prince Azura with ashen skin and fiery eyes, binding their fate to the Tribunal until the end of time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为对背叛因多里尔·尼瑞瓦的惩罚，暗精灵被迪德拉君王阿祖拉诅咒，皮肤化为灰烬色、双眼燃火，命运被束缚于审判席，直到时间终结。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Imperials are the well-spoken human denizens of Cyrodiil, known for the discipline and training of their citizen armies, as well as their respect for the rule of law.
ESP.TRADUIT: 帝国人是赛洛迪尔的健谈人类居民，以其公民军的纪律与训练以及对法治的尊重而闻名。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Many Imperials still venerate Tiber Septim as a god of the Nine Divines and, knowing well that dynasties rise and fall, hold faith that the Empire will one day reclaim its former glory.
ESP.TRADUIT: 许多帝国人仍将泰伯·塞普汀尊为九圣灵之一，并且深知王朝兴衰无常，仍相信帝国终有一日会重拾昔日荣光。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Along with their remarkable skills as light infantry, the Imperials are shrewd diplomats and traders - traits that have enabled them to conquer other nations and establish the Empire.
ESP.TRADUIT: 除了出色的轻步兵技能，帝国人还是精明的外交家与商人——这些特质使他们能够征服其他国家并建立帝国。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Khajiit are a feline race of beastfolk native to Elsweyr. Their intelligence and agility make them natural thieves and acrobats, while their ferocity makes them equally capable warriors.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡吉特是原生于艾斯维尔的猫科兽人种族。他们的智慧与敏捷使他们成为天生的盗贼和杂技演员，而他们的凶猛也使他们同样能成为战士。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Mane is a rare furstock, born when the moons are eclipsed, who serves as the spiritual leader of the Khajiit. Tradition holds that only one can exist at a time, continuously reborn into different bodies.
ESP.TRADUIT: “鬃毛”是一种罕见的毛皮形态，在双月食时出生，担任卡吉特的精神领袖。传统认为同一时间只能存在一位，并不断转生到不同的躯体中。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nirn's two moons, Masser and Secunda, are venerated as divine in Khajiiti culture. Their phases determine what shape a Khajiit takes at birth, ranging from the diminutive Alfiq to the imposing Pahmar.
ESP.TRADUIT: 奈恩的两颗卫星——马瑟尔和瑟坤达——在卡吉特文化中被奉为神明。它们的月相决定卡吉特出生时的形态，从微小的阿尔菲克到威猛的帕玛尔不等。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Nords are the tall and fair-haired human denizens of Skyrim, blessed with extraordinary resistance to cold and magical frost. They are renowned as fierce warriors who excel in all manner of warfare.
ESP.TRADUIT: 诺德人是天际的高个子、浅发人类居民，天生对寒冷和魔法冰霜有非凡抗性。他们以凶猛的战士著称，精通各种战斗方式。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Some sources trace the lineage of Nords to Atmora, while others believe Kyne breathed life into them atop the Throat of the World. Together, they suggest a migration of their ancestors from Skyrim to Atmora and back.
ESP.TRADUIT: 一些资料将诺德人的血统追溯到阿特莫拉，另一些人则认为凯娜在世界之喉上赋予了他们生命。两者共同暗示，他们的祖先曾从天际迁徙到阿特莫拉，再迁回天际。

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Wind is fundamental to Skyrim and the Nords; those that live in the far wastes always carry a wind with them." - Anonymous, Children of the Sky
ESP.TRADUIT: “风对天际和诺德人而言至关重要；生活在遥远荒原上的人总是随身带着风。”——佚名，《天空之子》

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Orcs are the mountain-dwelling elves of western Tamriel who founded Orsinium between Hammerfell and Skyrim. Their courage in battle and endurance of hardships mark them as formidable warriors.
ESP.TRADUIT: 兽人是泰姆瑞尔西部山居的精灵，在落锤与天际之间建立了奥辛纽姆。他们在战斗中的勇气与对苦难的忍耐，使他们成为强大的战士。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Orsimer revere Malacath as the First Orc and live by his code of honor and vengeance, which includes respect for the forge, a "Blood Price" for crimes, and the belief that death in battle pleases their god.
ESP.TRADUIT: 兽人崇奉玛拉凯斯为第一位兽人，并遵循他关于荣誉与复仇的准则，其中包括尊重锻炉、为罪行支付“血价”，以及相信战死能取悦他们的神。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not unlike their deity Malacath, the Orcs view themselves as outcasts. They uphold a distinct culture within secluded strongholds, where a single chieftain takes many wives.
ESP.TRADUIT: 与他们的神明玛拉凯斯相似，兽人视自己为被放逐者。他们在僻静的堡垒中维持着独特的文化，一位酋长可以娶多位妻子。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Redguards are the dark-skinned human denizens of Hammerfell. Their pride and independence of spirit make them better suited as skirmishers or adventurers than as rank-and-file soldiers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 红卫人是落锤的深肤色人类居民。他们的骄傲与独立精神，使他们更适合担任散兵或冒险者，而非普通列兵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: As descendants of the "Warrior Waves," who sailed to Tamriel from the fated land of Yokuda in the First Era, Redguards are renowned for their love of adventure and sailing the high seas.
ESP.TRADUIT: 作为第一纪元从命定之地尤库达航行至泰姆瑞尔的“战士之浪”的后裔，红卫人以热爱冒险和远洋航行而闻名。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The cultural identity of the Redguards is deeply rooted in the sands of the Alik'r Desert. The youth of Hammerfell must undergo a rite of passage in its desolate wastes to prove their endurance and discipline.
ESP.TRADUIT: 红卫人的文化身份深深植根于阿利克沙漠的沙土之中。落锤的年轻人必须在荒凉的沙漠中经历成年礼，以证明自己的耐力与纪律。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Ayleids were a powerful elven race with a culture steeped in magic and mystery. Having disappeared sometime in the First Era, their age-worn ruins are scattered across Cyrodiil.
ESP.TRADUIT: 亚历德是一个强大的精灵种族，其文化浸透着魔法与神秘。他们在第一纪元的某个时候消失，饱经岁月侵蚀的废墟散布在赛洛迪尔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Though none have been seen since the Second Era, legend has it that the Ayleids still dwell in the wild reaches of Tamriel.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽管自第二纪元以来再无人见过亚历德，传说他们仍居住在泰姆瑞尔的荒野深处。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Ayleid Empire fell in 1E 243 to the Slave-Queen Alessia, freeing the early Imperials from enslavement with the aid of Pelinal Whitestrake and the Demi-Prince Morihaus.
ESP.TRADUIT: 亚历德帝国于 1E 243 年亡于奴隶女王阿莱西亚之手，她在佩林纳尔·白斩与半神莫里豪斯的帮助下，将早期帝国人从奴役中解放出来。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dwarven artifacts and ruins are remnants of an ancient race of elves known to historians as the Dwemer, which roughly translates to "Deep Elves."
ESP.TRADUIT: 矮人器物与废墟是一个古老精灵种族的遗存，历史学家称之为锻莫，大致意为“深精灵”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The dwarves of Tamriel were named by giants and are more properly called the Dwemer. Though relics of their society scatter the continent, the elves themselves vanished millennia ago and are presumed extinct.
ESP.TRADUIT: 泰姆瑞尔的矮人由巨人命名，更准确的称呼是锻莫。尽管他们社会的遗物散布大陆，这些精灵本身已在数千年前消失，据推测已经灭绝。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Theories vary on why or how the Dwemer disappeared, but some believe that Lord Kagrenac, one of their chief architects, caused the event by tampering with the heart of a god.
ESP.TRADUIT: 关于锻莫消失的原因与方式，理论各异，但一些人认为他们的首席建筑师之一卡格瑞纳克领主因篡改一位神的心脏而引发了这一事件。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Dragon Cult built high temples to honor the dragons and inter the faithful. Many still stand as forsaken ruins, haunted in undeath by those entombed within.
ESP.TRADUIT: 巨龙教团建造高耸的神庙来荣耀巨龙并安葬信徒。许多神庙仍作为废弃废墟矗立，被埋葬其中的亡者以亡灵之身萦绕。

ESP.ORIGINAL: In days of old, when dragons ruled over the land, there lived mortal men who worshipped them as gods. This Dragon Cult has long since died out, though their ruins still loom over Skyrim.
ESP.TRADUIT: 古时，巨龙统治大地，有凡人将它们奉为神明。这个巨龙教团早已消亡，但他们的废墟仍矗立在天际之上。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The ancient Nords followed the Old Ways: the worship of animal gods, most notably the dragon, in the form of totems.
ESP.TRADUIT: 古诺德人遵循古老方式：以图腾形式崇拜动物神，其中最著名的是龙。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nordic ruins often contain word walls, inscribed with long-forgotten power through words in the Dragon Language - a series of etched runes resembling claw marks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 诺德废墟中常有文字墙，上面刻着龙语词语所承载的早已被遗忘的力量——一系列类似爪痕的符文。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Nords believe the Storm Voice is a gift from Kyne, through which a Tongue can channel their vital essence into a Shout - a powerful form of magic once unique to dragons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 诺德人相信风暴之音是凯娜的恩赐，舌者可以通过它将自身生命力注入吼声——一种曾为巨龙独有的强大魔法。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Much like the names of dragons, a shout in the Dragon Language consists of three words of power, with each spoken word increasing the shout's strength.
ESP.TRADUIT: 与巨龙的名字很像，龙语中的吼声由三个力量之词组成，每说出一个词都会增强吼声的威力。

ESP.ORIGINAL: By invoking Dragon Aspect, skilled wielders of the Voice can enhance their attack power, bolster their defense with spectral armor, and hasten shout recovery.
ESP.TRADUIT: 通过唤起“龙之化身”，熟练的“声音”使用者能提升攻击力、以幽灵护甲强化防御，并加快吼声恢复。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shouts may turn the tide of battle when used strategically, but their application extends beyond combat - to swiftly crossing distances, sharpening blades, or altering the weather.
ESP.TRADUIT: 吼声若运用得当，可以扭转战局，但其用途远不止战斗——还能快速跨越距离、磨利刀刃或改变天气。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Learning to use the Thu'um typically demands many years of meditation and training. The most powerful Tongues can cause great devastation with so little as a whisper.
ESP.TRADUIT: 学习使用“吼声”通常需要多年冥想与训练。最强大的舌者只需低语，便能造成巨大破坏。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Soul Tear shout binds the soul of its target, siphons their health, and - should they fall within two seconds - raises their corpse to fight for the caster.
ESP.TRADUIT: “灵魂撕裂”吼声会束缚目标的灵魂，吸取其生命，并且——如果目标在两秒内倒下——就会复活其尸体为施法者作战。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The three words of Unrelenting Force (Force, Balance, Push) chain together to hurl objects great distances and briefly render enemies helpless.
ESP.TRADUIT: “无情之力”的三个词（力、均衡、推）串联起来，能将物体抛向远方，并短暂使敌人失去行动能力。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The ancient Nords erected many word walls across the land. Their true power lies dormant, awaiting a worthy Dragonborn - and the souls of slain dragons - to awaken it.
ESP.TRADUIT: 古诺德人在大地上竖立了许多文字墙。它们真正的力量处于休眠状态，等待一位值得的龙裔——以及被杀巨龙的灵魂——来唤醒。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Understanding the magical properties of enchanted gear requires study at an enchanting table - a process that ultimately results in the items' destruction.
ESP.TRADUIT: 要理解附魔装备的魔法特性，需要在附魔台上进行研究——这一过程最终会摧毁物品。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The skills of a smith are used to craft new weapons and armor from raw materials, as well as to improve existing gear.
ESP.TRADUIT: 铁匠的技能用于从原材料打造新的武器和护甲，也用于改进现有装备。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The efficacy of stealth depends on several factors, such as enemy sightlines, cumbersomeness of worn armor, quickness of pace, and availability of shadow.
ESP.TRADUIT: 潜行的效果取决于多种因素，例如敌人的视线、所穿护甲的笨重程度、移动速度以及可用的阴影。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Skills improve through experience and practical application, but may also be taught by those adept in their respective fields.
ESP.TRADUIT: 技能通过经验与实际应用提高，但也可以由各自领域的能手传授。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alchemy is the art of mixing, boiling, and distilling raw ingredients to harness their properties for the brewing of potions and poisons.
ESP.TRADUIT: 炼金术是混合、煮沸和蒸馏原材料的技艺，利用其特性来调制药水与毒药。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Alchemists commonly consume samples of ingredients to determine their properties - be they beneficial or harmful.
ESP.TRADUIT: 炼金师通常会品尝少量材料，以判断其特性——无论有益还是有害。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Poisons are brewed substances that inflict detrimental effects upon their target, capable of damaging health, magicka, and stamina.
ESP.TRADUIT: 毒药是调制出的物质，会对目标造成负面效果，能够伤害生命、魔力和耐力。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The strategic use of potions and other consumables can mean the difference between life and death, granting an upper hand in the midst of battle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 战略性地使用药水和其他消耗品可能决定生死，在战斗中占据上风。

ESP.ORIGINAL: By letting down the bowstring, an archer can reconsider their aim and return an arrow to the quiver. A heavy blade is less forgiving mid-strike.
ESP.TRADUIT: 弓箭手可以松开弓弦，重新考虑瞄准，并把箭收回箭袋。沉重的刀刃在挥砍中途则没那么宽容。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Fully drawing a bow before loosing an arrow results in a more precise and powerful shot with the greatest possible range.
ESP.TRADUIT: 放箭前将弓完全拉满，能射出更精准、更有力、射程最远的箭。

ESP.ORIGINAL: While a weapon in hand might suffice to block incoming blows, a shield provides a more effective means of defense.
ESP.TRADUIT: 手中的武器或许足以格挡来袭的攻击，但盾牌能提供更有效的防御手段。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Brawls can settle disputes or test an opponent's mettle with nothing but fists. Such contests showcase prowess, and establish respect and camaraderie among friends and rivals alike.
ESP.TRADUIT: 斗殴可以只用拳头解决争端或试探对手的胆量。这种较量展示本领，并在朋友与对手之间建立尊重与情谊。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those trained to use one-handed weapons can adeptly wield daggers, swords, maces, and war axes, leaving their off-hand free to hold a shield or an additional weapon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 受过单手武器训练的人能熟练使用匕首、剑、锤和战斧，空出副手来持盾或另一件武器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Surprise attacks against unsuspecting victims are generally more lethal than ones that are openly declared, even when the same level of force is used.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对毫无防备的受害者发动突袭，通常比公开宣战的攻击更致命，即使使用的力量相同。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Those trained to use two-handed weapons deliver deadlier blows with greatswords, battleaxes, and warhammers.
ESP.TRADUIT: 受过双手武器训练的人，能用巨剑、战斧和战锤造成更致命的打击。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Ruby Throne in Cyrodiil's White-Gold Tower has been the ruling seat of the Empire of Tamriel since the First Empire of Saint Alessia. As of the Fourth Era, the Third Empire comprises only Skyrim, High Rock, and Cyrodiil.
ESP.TRADUIT: 赛洛迪尔白金塔中的红宝石王座，自圣阿莱西亚的第一帝国以来一直是泰姆瑞尔帝国的统治宝座。到第四纪元，第三帝国仅包括天际、高岩和赛洛迪尔。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Black Marsh, also known as Argonia, is a dense swampland region in southeastern Tamriel inhabited by the Argonians. It is a land teeming with poisonous plants and violent predators.
ESP.TRADUIT: 黑沼，又称阿尔戈尼亚，是泰姆瑞尔东南部一片茂密的沼泽地区，居住着阿尔贡人。这片土地上遍布有毒植物和凶猛的掠食者。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cyrodiil, sometimes called "the Heartland," is a temperate province in central Tamriel from which the Imperials hail. It holds the Empire's capital, the Imperial City, with the White-Gold Tower at its heart.
ESP.TRADUIT: 赛洛迪尔有时被称为“心脏之地”，是泰姆瑞尔中部一个气候温和的省份，帝国人便来自这里。它拥有帝国首都帝都，白金塔位于其中心。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Elsweyr lies on the southern coast of Tamriel and is home to the feline Khajiit. The land is divided by two distinct climates: arid wastes in the north, and fertile jungle in the south.
ESP.TRADUIT: 艾斯维尔位于泰姆瑞尔南部海岸，是猫科卡吉特的家园。这片土地被两种截然不同的气候分隔：北方干旱的荒原和南方肥沃的丛林。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hammerfell is a rugged province in western Tamriel from which the Redguards hail. The region boasts a variety of landscapes, including subtropical beaches, lush jungles, and the vast Alik'r Desert.
ESP.TRADUIT: 落锤是泰姆瑞尔西部一个崎岖的省份，红卫人便来自这里。该地区拥有多样的地貌，包括亚热带海滩、茂密丛林和广袤的阿利克沙漠。

ESP.ORIGINAL: High Rock in northwestern Tamriel is the homeland of the Bretons and once held the kingdom of the Orcs. Featuring temperate forests, dry badlands, and snowy mountains, it is a land as diverse as its people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 泰姆瑞尔西北部的高岩是布莱顿人的家园，也曾是兽人王国的所在地。这里有温带森林、干燥的荒地和积雪的山脉，土地与其人民一样多样。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Morrowind is a volcanic region in northeastern Tamriel from which the Dark Elves hail. The mainland is isolated by vast mountain ranges, with the island of Vvardenfell and the ash-spewing Red Mountain at its core.
ESP.TRADUIT: 晨风是泰姆瑞尔东北部一个火山地区，暗精灵便来自这里。大陆被广阔的山脉隔绝，核心是瓦登费尔岛和喷吐灰烬的红山。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Skyrim is the northernmost province of Tamriel and homeland of the Nords, who long ago conquered the Snow Elves. It is a cold and rugged region containing four of the five tallest mountains on the continent.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天际是泰姆瑞尔最北部的省份，也是诺德人的家园，他们很久以前征服了雪精灵。这是一个寒冷崎岖的地区，拥有大陆上五座最高山峰中的四座。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Summerset Isles lie southwest of Tamriel in the Sea of Pearls and are home to the High Elves. Consisting of fourteen islands, they make up a warm region with colorful forests and idyllic meadows.
ESP.TRADUIT: 夏暮群岛位于泰姆瑞尔西南的珍珠海，是高精灵的家园。它由十四个岛屿组成，构成一个拥有绚丽森林和田园牧歌般草甸的温暖地区。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Valenwood is a densely forested region in southwestern Tamriel, inhabited by the Wood Elves. Its rainforests are roamed by gigantic, migratory trees whose branches host entire cities.
ESP.TRADUIT: 瓦伦森林是泰姆瑞尔西南部一片森林茂密的地区，居住着木精灵。其雨林中游荡着巨大的迁徙树木，树枝上承载着整座城市。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Navigating the rugged northern landscape is easier astride a horse, available for purchase from the stables in any of Skyrim's major settlements.
ESP.TRADUIT: 骑马穿行崎岖的北方大地更为轻松，天际任何主要定居点的马厩都出售马匹。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The horses of Skyrim may be slower than those from Cyrodiil, but what they lack in swiftness is made up for in hardiness.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天际的马可能比赛洛迪尔的马慢，但它们缺乏的速度由坚韧弥补。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Riverwood is a logging town on the White River that has thrived since the Merethic Era, resting beneath the shadow of Bleak Falls Barrow to its west.
ESP.TRADUIT: 河木镇是白河畔的伐木小镇，自精灵纪元以来一直繁荣，坐落在其西面荒瀑古坟的阴影之下。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Soldiers from both sides of the civil war are known to establish camps in enemy-controlled regions, offering shelter and provisions for their faction's troops.
ESP.TRADUIT: 内战双方的士兵都会在敌方控制的地区建立营地，为所属阵营的部队提供庇护和补给。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Vampire Lords can assume a bat-like form at will, complete with deadly talons and leathery wings. While transformed, they wield powerful spells and evade danger by shifting into a cloud of bats.
ESP.TRADUIT: 吸血鬼领主可以随意化作蝙蝠般的形态，拥有致命的利爪和皮革般的翅膀。变身时，它们能施展强大法术，并通过化作一群蝙蝠来躲避危险。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Werewolves are skin-changers infected with lycanthropy, a contagious supernatural disease that seeps into the spirit. Their bloodthirsty nature has left them widely reviled.
ESP.TRADUIT: 狼人是感染了狼人化的变形者，这是一种渗入灵魂的传染性超自然疾病。其嗜血本性使它们广受憎恶。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The daedra known to themselves as "Kyn" use the term "Dremora" when dealing with mortals to prevent their true names from being weaponized against them.
ESP.TRADUIT: 这些迪德拉自称“凯恩”，但在与凡人打交道时使用“魔人”一词，以防真名被用来对付它们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dremora are fierce combatants not only due to their prowess as warriors and sorcerers, but also because, as creatures of Oblivion, they face no fear of death.
ESP.TRADUIT: 魔人是凶猛的战斗者，不仅因为它们是战士和法师，还因为作为湮灭生物，它们不惧怕死亡。

ESP.ORIGINAL: "I begin every service in the temple with a prayer to praise Alduin (oh great god of time!), followed by a prayer to keep him at bay (may your slumber stretch on for a thousand generations!)." - High Priest Ingurt, Divines and the Nords
ESP.TRADUIT: “我在神庙的每一次礼拜都以赞美奥杜因的祈祷开始（哦，伟大的时间之神！），随后是让他远离的祈祷（愿您的长眠延续千秋万代！）。”——大祭司英古特，《圣灵与诺德人》

ESP.ORIGINAL: Once, the dragons sought to eliminate or enslave all mortal races. Given the chance, they would surely do so again...
ESP.TRADUIT: 曾经，巨龙试图消灭或奴役所有凡人种族。一旦有机会，它们必定会再次这样做……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Revered dragons stand out from their kin with a beaked mouth and distinct lack of teeth. The true danger lies in their unique shout, which drains the life force of its unlucky targets.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尊龙以其喙状嘴和明显缺少牙齿而在同类中脱颖而出。真正的危险在于它们独特的吼声，能吸取不幸目标的生命力。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Liches are necromancers who have shed mortality itself to embrace the most sophisticated form of undeath. Dragon Priests are a particular Nordic variety.
ESP.TRADUIT: 巫妖是舍去凡人之躯、拥抱最复杂亡灵形态的死灵法师。龙祭司是诺德人的一种特殊巫妖。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Vigil of Stendarr is an order of holy warriors who dedicate themselves to eradicating daedra and other "abominations" in the name of the Divine they revere.
ESP.TRADUIT: 斯丹达尔警觉会是一支神圣战士教团，以他们所崇敬的圣灵之名，致力于消灭迪德拉和其他“可憎之物”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Adventurers need not face the perils of their journeys alone. Many across the realm seek companions in the trials and triumphs of their quests, drawn together by common goals.
ESP.TRADUIT: 冒险者不必独自面对旅途中的危险。这片土地上许多人都在任务的试炼与胜利中寻找同伴，因共同目标而走到一起。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Hoarding more loot than can be easily carried often proves unwise. An overburdened traveler will find their journey slowed and threats harder to evade.
ESP.TRADUIT: 囤积超过轻松携带量的战利品往往不明智。负担过重的旅行者会发现旅途变慢，威胁更难躲避。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Game is abundant in Skyrim's countryside, ripe for the harvest. Many hunters roam the wilds in pursuit of elk and other animals, occasionally trading their spoils along the way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天际的乡村猎物丰富，可供收获。许多猎人游荡在荒野中追逐麋鹿和其他动物，偶尔沿途交易猎物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A Dark Brotherhood assassin practices the art of murder, understanding that every kill demands payment - in the form of gold, a jail cell, or more bloodshed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 黑暗兄弟会刺客修炼谋杀之术，深知每一次杀戮都要付出代价——金币、牢房，或更多流血。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Soul gems are sized according to the strength of souls they can capture, ranging from petty to grand. Molag Bal is rumored to have created them with a portion of his infernal power.
ESP.TRADUIT: 灵魂石按其能捕获的灵魂强度分为不同大小，从微小到宏大。据传莫拉格·巴尔用自己的一部分地狱力量创造了它们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ebony is a durable volcanic glass refined by folding many times upon itself. Said to be the crystallized blood of Lorkhan, it is one of Tamriel's most precious substances.
ESP.TRADUIT: 黑檀是一种耐用的火山玻璃，经过多次折叠精炼而成。据说它是洛克汗结晶的血液，是泰姆瑞尔最珍贵的物质之一。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The bold adventurer may unearth hidden treasures in Skyrim's darkest depths, but countless dangers await in the shadows... and some are better left undisturbed.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大胆的冒险者或许能在天际最幽暗的深处发掘隐藏的宝藏，但阴影中潜伏着无数危险……有些东西最好别去打扰。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Blackreach is an immense, naturally-lit cavern that can be accessed through certain Dwarven ruins and once served as a highway connecting several Dwemeri cities.
ESP.TRADUIT: 黑境是一座巨大的、自然发光的洞窟，可通过某些矮人废墟进入，曾是连接数座锻莫城市的通道。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dragon Breaks occur when the flow of time is fractured, historically blamed on mortals meddling in divine matters. They often precede significant changes in Tamriel that strain mortal comprehension.
ESP.TRADUIT: 当时间之流发生断裂时，就会出现龙破，历史上常归咎于凡人干预神的事务。龙破往往先于泰姆瑞尔发生超出凡人理解的重大变化。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Sovngarde is the storied afterlife of the Nords, ruled by Shor as a part of Aetherius. It is where the greatest Nord heroes journey upon death to enjoy an eternity of feasting and revelry.
ESP.TRADUIT: 松加德是诺德人传说中的来世，由舒尔统治，是光界的一部分。最伟大的诺德英雄死后会前往那里，享受永恒的宴饮与狂欢。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Spells may be prepared in either hand to be dual-wielded by skilled casters, or held in one hand while the other holds a weapon.
ESP.TRADUIT: 法术可以在任一只手中准备，由熟练的施法者双持，也可以一手持法术、另一手持武器。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Magicka is the raw energy of magic that flows from Aetherius into Mundus via the sun and stars. Known to mages as the Higher Arts, it has many purposes: to heal, to harm, or to fulfill selfish ends.
ESP.TRADUIT: 魔力是从光界经由太阳与星辰流入凡世的原始魔法能量。法师称之为高阶技艺，它有许多用途：治疗、伤害，或达成自私的目的。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Armamancy is the practice of conjuring bound weapons. During its brief time in Tamriel, a bound weapon is essentially a daedra confined to a magical form.
ESP.TRADUIT: 武器召唤是召唤束缚武器的技艺。束缚武器在泰姆瑞尔存在的短暂时间里，本质上是一个被禁锢在魔法形态中的迪德拉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Pacify is a spell from the School of Illusion that compels weaker enemies to cease their attacks for a brief time.
ESP.TRADUIT: 安抚术是幻术系法术，能迫使较弱的敌人短暂停止攻击。

ESP.ORIGINAL: By casting Soul Trap on a creature at the moment of its death, a spellcaster may capture its soul in a soul gem - provided one of suitable size is empty and available.
ESP.TRADUIT: 在生物死亡的那一刻对其施放灵魂陷阱，施法者就可以将其灵魂捕获到灵魂石中——前提是有一块大小合适且空置的灵魂石。

ESP.ORIGINAL: "The people of Solstheim, the heirs of the Guardian, must remain wary, lest the dark influence of Herma-Mora, or even the Traitor himself, return someday." - Lucius Gallus, The Guardian and the Traitor
ESP.TRADUIT: “索瑟海姆的人民，守护者的继承者，必须保持警惕，以免赫玛-莫拉的黑暗影响，甚至叛徒本人，有朝一日卷土重来。”——卢修斯·加卢斯，《守护者与叛徒》

ESP.ORIGINAL: The High King of Skyrim formally ceded the island of Solstheim to Morrowind in 4E 16 to serve as a refuge for the Dunmer following the devastation of the Red Year.
ESP.TRADUIT: 天际至高王于 4E 16 年正式将索瑟海姆岛割让给晨风，作为红年灾难后暗精灵的避难所。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Precision is vital for an archer faced with a long shot, as they might have only one chance to hit their target before it escapes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 对面临远距离射击的弓箭手来说，精准至关重要，因为他们可能只有一次命中目标的机会，否则目标就会逃走。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Dual wielding weapons can greatly enhance a combatant's melee damage by allowing both hands to strike simultaneously.
ESP.TRADUIT: 双持武器可以让双手同时攻击，从而大幅提高战斗者的近战伤害。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The old Nord phrase "season unending" casts war as an endless cycle, where combatants pause only to gather strength before the next battle.
ESP.TRADUIT: 诺德古语“无尽之季”将战争描绘成无休止的循环，交战者只是停下来积蓄力量，准备下一场战斗。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Serving under the authority of the Emperor, the Imperial Legion - with its vast numbers and strict discipline - is regarded as one of the most powerful fighting forces ever assembled.
ESP.TRADUIT: 帝国军团在皇帝的权威下服役，以其庞大的数量和严明的纪律，被视为有史以来最强大的战斗力量之一。

ESP.ORIGINAL: No one agrees whether the Empire branded them "Stormcloaks" as an insult, or if Ulfric coined the name himself. Regardless, the rebels wear it like armor in their fight for a free Skyrim.
ESP.TRADUIT: 没人能确定“风暴斗篷”是帝国为侮辱他们而起，还是乌弗瑞克自己创造的。无论如何，叛军在为自由天际而战时，将它像铠甲一样穿在身上。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Stripped of their power in the Dragon War, dragons were largely killed off thereafter and vanished from Tamriel. The few who survived did so in seclusion and obscurity, believed extinct by almost all.
ESP.TRADUIT: 巨龙在巨龙战争中被剥夺力量，此后大部分遭到杀戮，从泰姆瑞尔消失。少数幸存者隐居在默默无闻之处，几乎所有人都认为它们已经灭绝。

ESP.ORIGINAL: For all of Skyrim's beauty, her dangers are plentiful. Brave explorers will face all manner of enemies on their journeys, from restless spirits and vampires to otherworldly monsters.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽管天际美丽，危险也层出不穷。勇敢的探险者会在旅途中遭遇各种敌人，从不安的亡魂、吸血鬼到异界怪物。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Mythic Dawn called their enemies the "Dragon's Blood," evoking Queen Alessia's covenant with Akatosh that shielded Nirn from Oblivion - and the line of rulers who kept the Dragonfires burning.
ESP.TRADUIT: 神话黎明将他们的敌人称为“龙之血”，这让人想起阿莱西亚女王与阿卡托什的盟约——它保护奈恩免受湮灭侵扰——以及维持龙火不灭的统治者血脉。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Operating in strict secrecy, the Blades shared their missions with only an elite few and maintained hidden strongholds across Tamriel where they could live and train unseen.
ESP.TRADUIT: 刀锋会严格秘密行动，只与极少数精英分享任务，并在泰姆瑞尔各地维持隐秘据点，使他们能够在无人知晓的情况下生活和训练。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Breaking the law is frowned upon by most people. Those with a penchant for crime will quickly overstay their welcome among decent folk.
ESP.TRADUIT: 大多数人都反感违法。有犯罪倾向的人在正派人中间会很快不受欢迎。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Crimes earn bounties in the holds where they occur - if someone happens to witness them. Local guards will attempt an arrest, and fleeing only invites a chase.
ESP.TRADUIT: 犯罪会在发生的领内招来赏金——前提是恰好有人目击。当地守卫会试图逮捕，逃跑只会招来追捕。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A map is just one way to navigate Skyrim. Road signs are posted at crossroads throughout the province, pointing travelers toward cities, villages, and prominent landmarks.
ESP.TRADUIT: 地图只是在天际导航的一种方式。省内各十字路口都设有路标，指引旅人前往城市、村庄和著名地标。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Not all coin is honest, and not all work is clean. Those willing to get their hands dirty may find good pay either way.
ESP.TRADUIT: 并非所有钱都来得正当，也不是所有工作都干净。愿意弄脏双手的人，无论如何都能找到不错的报酬。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The standing stones that dot Skyrim's landscape correspond to the constellations within Tamriel's night sky. Among them, the Warrior, the Mage, and the Thief stand together as the "guardians."
ESP.TRADUIT: 点缀天际景观的符文石与泰姆瑞尔夜空中的星座相对应。其中，战士、法师和盗贼三块石头并立，被称为“守护者”。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Bards College is Skyrim's foremost school for aspiring bards - or "skalds," as they are known in the province.
ESP.TRADUIT: 吟游诗人学院是天际培养有抱负的吟游诗人——或该省所称的“诗匠”——的首要学校。

ESP.ORIGINAL: A mage's robes trade the protection of armor for greater freedom of spellcasting. They often carry enchantments to enhance the wearer's magical abilities.
ESP.TRADUIT: 法师长袍以放弃护甲保护为代价，换取更大的施法自由度。它们通常带有附魔，以增强佩戴者的魔法能力。

ESP.ORIGINAL: War axes strike a balance between speed and power, swinging faster than maces, and delivering more damage than swords.
ESP.TRADUIT: 战斧在速度与力量之间取得平衡，挥舞比锤快，伤害比剑高。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Crossbows are slow to reload, but their bolts strike with a force few bows can match. They can be held at the ready without strain, lending the marksman more time to aim true.
ESP.TRADUIT: 弩装填缓慢，但其弩矢的冲击力少有弓能匹敌。弩可以毫不费力地保持待发状态，让射手有更多时间瞄准。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Warhammers are slow and cumbersome, demanding two strong hands to wield them, but their power is devastating - a well-placed blow can stagger even the largest foes.
ESP.TRADUIT: 战锤缓慢笨重，需要两只强壮的手才能挥舞，但其威力极具毁灭性——一记精准的打击甚至能让最大的敌人踉跄。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Amulet of Kings symbolized the divine right of the Cyrodiilic emperors. Its near four-thousand-year history ended when it was shattered in the Third Era to seal shut the gates of Oblivion forever.
ESP.TRADUIT: 君王护符象征赛洛迪尔皇帝的神授统治权。它近四千年的历史在第三纪元终结，被击碎以永远封死湮灭之门。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Saint Alessia was long hailed as the first Dragonborn in history, until Miraak's reappearance in the Fourth Era raised a far older claim to the title.
ESP.TRADUIT: 圣阿莱西亚长期被尊为历史上第一位龙裔，直到米拉克在第四纪元重现，提出了更古老的头衔主张。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Empire withdrew its legions from Morrowind during the Oblivion Crisis, and lacked the strength to return. This seeming indifference to their plight drove the Dunmer to retake their homeland for themselves.
ESP.TRADUIT: 帝国在湮灭危机期间从晨风撤走军团，此后无力返回。这种对他们困境的明显漠视，促使暗精灵自行夺回家园。

ESP.ORIGINAL: "Are you in need of a flame spell? Conjure a Flame Atronach. You'll have command of a dozen such spells in the form of a fiery avatar." - Warlock Aldaale, Where Magical Paths Meet
ESP.TRADUIT: “你需要火焰法术吗？召唤一个火焰元素。你将驾驭十几种这样的法术，化身为炽热的化身。”——术士阿尔达勒，《魔法之路交汇处》

ESP.ORIGINAL: Spell tomes teach the reader a new spell, if they have sufficient skill in the relevant school. They can be purchased from merchants, court wizards, or specialists in the College of Winterhold.
ESP.TRADUIT: 法术书能让读者学会新法术，前提是其在相关学派有足够技能。它们可以从商人、宫廷法师或冬堡学院的专家处购买。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Using Reanimate spells, resourceful mages can compel even corpses to fight for them. Whereas a conjurer is limited to the summons they've learned, fallen enemies are never in short supply.
ESP.TRADUIT: 使用复活法术，足智多谋的法师甚至能迫使尸体为他们作战。召唤师受限于已学会的召唤物，而倒下的敌人却从不短缺。

ESP.ORIGINAL: High Elves regard themselves as the purest, most unaltered heirs of the Aldmer - the ancient elves who first arrived on Tamriel from the mythical lost continent of Aldmeris.
ESP.TRADUIT: 高精灵视自己为奥德莫最纯粹、最未受改变的后裔——奥德莫是最早从神话中失落的奥德莫瑞斯大陆来到泰姆瑞尔的古老精灵。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The Hist connects every Argonian in Black Marsh, where its sap is ingested to mark namings, bondings, and passages into death. The darkest rituals use sacrifice to keep lurking things beneath the mires...
ESP.TRADUIT: 希斯特连接着黑沼的每一个阿尔贡人，其树液会被饮下，以标记命名、结合与死亡仪式。最黑暗的仪式会用献祭来安抚沼泽下潜伏的东西……

ESP.ORIGINAL: Wood Elves rejected stiff Aldmeri culture for a simpler existence in harmony with the land. Nimble of body and mind, they are dismissed by their more "civilized" cousins as unruly and naive.
ESP.TRADUIT: 木精灵摒弃僵硬的奥德莫文化，选择与土地和谐共处的简朴生活。他们身心敏捷，却被更“文明”的同族视为不守规矩、天真幼稚。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Shorter lifespans put the Bretons at a disadvantage against elves, yet they have produced some of history's greatest mages - second only to the Altmer, with room to surpass them given the chance.
ESP.TRADUIT: 较短的寿命使布莱顿人相对于精灵处于劣势，但他们孕育了历史上一些最伟大的法师——仅次于高精灵，若有机会，甚至可能超越他们。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Outsiders may call the Dunmer proud, clannish, and quick-tempered, yet they value family and loyalty above all. Tempered by centuries of conflict, they remain a resilient and talented people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 外人或许会说暗精灵骄傲、宗族观念重、脾气急躁，但他们最重视家庭与忠诚。历经数百年冲突磨炼，他们仍是坚韧而富有才华的民族。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Cosmopolitanism defines Imperial culture, itself a blend of Colovian, Nibenese, and Akaviri traditions. Amid their own divisions and bordering many provinces, the Imperials are practiced at building bridges and keeping order.
ESP.TRADUIT: 世界主义定义了帝国文化，它本身融合了科洛文、尼本尼和阿卡维尔传统。尽管内部存在分裂，且与多个省份接壤，帝国人仍擅长搭建桥梁与维持秩序。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Khajiit are a type of Betmeri, the so-called "beast races" - a term popularized by the Reman Empire to justify conquering them. Though their nature sometimes draws prejudice, they answer it with pride, not shame.
ESP.TRADUIT: 卡吉特是兽人的一种，即所谓“兽族”——这一术语由雷曼帝国推广，以为征服他们辩护。尽管他们的天性有时招致偏见，他们以骄傲而非羞耻回应。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Ysgramor gathered the Five Hundred Companions to avenge the razing of Saarthal in the Night of Tears. Untold numbers of elves fell to their blades, leaving the Nords with a bitter resentment for elvenkind that endures still.
ESP.TRADUIT: 伊斯格拉默召集五百勇士，为“泪之夜”中萨瑟尔被焚毁而复仇。无数精灵死于他们的刀下，使诺德人对精灵怀有至今未消的深切怨恨。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Despite their long-standing reputation as mere barbarians, Orcs are as cultured as any other race in Tamriel, having ever striven to be recognized as actual people.
ESP.TRADUIT: 尽管长期以来背负着只是野蛮人的名声，兽人却和泰姆瑞尔任何其他种族一样有文化，一直努力被承认为真正的人。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Nearly all Redguards are taught to fight, but only the fittest become true warriors. They must face death to prove themselves, and it is never far - even their pastime of snake charming tempts its grasp.
ESP.TRADUIT: 几乎所有红卫人都被教导战斗，但只有最强健者才能成为真正的战士。他们必须直面死亡来证明自己，而死亡从不遥远——甚至他们弄蛇的消遣也会招来它的魔爪。

ESP.ORIGINAL: The stealthiest approach can still be undone by a single careless footstep, a flickering torch, or the sharp eyes of a watchful guard.
ESP.TRADUIT: 最隐秘的接近也可能被一个不小心的脚步、一支摇曳的火把，或警惕守卫锐利的目光所破坏。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Combat skills must be sharpened with practice, and are best tested when pitted against worthy opponents.
ESP.TRADUIT: 战斗技能必须通过练习磨砺，最好在与值得的对手较量中检验。

ESP.ORIGINAL: Unarmed combat requires only a fighter's fists, ready even when a blade is out of reach. Some hone this skill deliberately, while the beast races carry claws as weapons all their own.
ESP.TRADUIT: 徒手战斗只需要战士的拳头，即使刀刃不在手边也能随时应战。有些人刻意磨练这项技能，而兽族则天生拥有爪子作为武器。
